outcome: Expression of Toll-like receptors (TLR2, TLR3, TLR4, TLR7, TLR8, TLR9) on peripheral blood lymphocyte subpopulations (CD4+, CD8+, CD19+ cells)
Levels of soluble forms of TLRs in serum and urine
cohort: The study cohort consisted of women diagnosed with endometriosis and a healthy control group, all of whom were not undergoing hormonal bridging therapy or using hormonal contraception.
finding: Patients with endometriosis showed increased expression of Toll-like receptors in lymphocyte populations compared to the control group, suggesting their role in endometriosis immunopathogenesis and potential as diagnostic biomarkers.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time from women diagnosed with endometriosis and healthy controls.
